title: On Hearing the bell from three fields away
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：hear　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hear 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the grandmother ① heard the bell from three fields away before dawn, and every child in the courtyard said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the grandmother ② hears the bell from three fields away in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ hear the bell from three fields away at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ heard the bell from three fields away before — a line in the diary for February 1962 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Hearing the bell from three fields away before dawn, the grandmother said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ hear of the old road years later in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Hear of the old road years later at once and never mention it again.

By 1975 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the diary, and a new child from the next courtyard ⑧ hears of the old road years later before dawn every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the window, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ heard the bell from three fields away again when nobody else would.

⑩ To hear the bell from three fields away, my mother said in 1980, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the courtyard remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the courtyard forgets, somebody hears the bell from three fields away in public again and somebody must hear the bell from three fields away before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 听见（一般过去式 heard the bell from three fields away：1968 年祖母头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 听见（一般现在 hears the bell from three fields away：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 听见（不定式 to hear the bell from three fields away：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 听见（过去完成时 had heard the bell from three fields away：1962 年二月的日记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 听见（动名词 hearing the bell from three fields away 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 听说（hear of the old road years later：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去听说多年后才听说那条旧路）
G. v. 听说（hear of the old road years later：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 听见（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 hears of the old road years later，而母亲又一次 heard the bell from three fields away）

answers.why: hear 意为“听见”，1968 年祖母天没亮就听见隔着三块田听见那口钟，那是院子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 heard。
hear 意为“听见”，自那以后祖母当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 hears。
hear 意为“听见”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯听见隔着三块田听见那口钟”，此处为不定式 to hear the bell from three fields away。
hear 意为“听见”，日记里 二月 那行字说明早在 1975 年之前就有人听见过，故用过去完成时 had heard。
hear 意为“听见”，祖母说“听见隔着三块田听见那口钟这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 hearing the bell from three fields away 作主语。
hear 意为“听说”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去听说多年后才听说那条旧路”，should ever 之后用原形 hear of the old road years later。
hear 意为“听说”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻听说多年后才听说那条旧路（hear of the old road years later at once），以后再也不要提起。
hear 意为“听见”，新来的孩子每个年头都照例听说多年后才听说那条旧路，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 hears。
hear 意为“听见”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就听见隔着三块田听见那口钟，用一般过去式 heard 叙述。
hear 意为“听见”，结尾那句是母亲 1980 年的话：要听见隔着三块田听见那口钟，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和院子记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 hear 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the grandmother heard the bell from three fields away before dawn, and nobody in the courtyard forgot it.
Even now the grandmother hears the bell from three fields away in public whenever the courtyard asks.
Hearing the bell from three fields away before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever hear of the old road years later in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next courtyard hears of the old road years later before dawn every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother heard the bell from three fields away again, and the courtyard remembered that half.
